verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is self-hosted (docs-5, docs-23), so operators inherently control where the proxy itself runs, and the enterprise tier explicitly offers 'Multi-region deployment under one license' (litellm-docs-38), implying some regional control. However there is no explicit data-residency feature, no per-request/region routing of data storage, and no documentation describing compliance-grade residency guarantees or log/data storage location controls. Missing for 10: explicit data residency/region-pinning configuration, documentation on where logs/cache/spend data are stored, and independent confirmation of multi-region enterprise feature in practice.
